structured_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-16 with claim-level MOA N286 (missing/invalid referring provider NPI). The 837P party list contains no referring provider loop. Medicare Part B FFS: correct and resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1) with the ordering/referring provider name and NPI populated and verified in PECOS. Filing clock: DOS 2026-07-20; Medicare 1-year limit is 2027-07-20 — time remains.

root_cause.explanation: MOA N286 on the remit and no referring provider loop in the 837P: ordering/referring NPI absent from the claim. CO-16 applied to all three lines.

next_action.detail: Add the referring/ordering provider name and NPI to the claim; verify against NPI Registry and PECOS. Resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) — Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7.

evidence.fact: MOA N286: missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier; CO-16 on all three service lines, $0 paid.
evidence.locator: CLP PA25851339 / MOA N286 / CAS CO-16 lines 1-3

evidence.fact: Claim parties list billing, rendering, submitter, payer, and insured — no referring provider (2310A loop) present.
Claim accepted for adjudication (A2/status 20) — an 835 was produced; resubmit as corrected new original, not an appeal.

citations.rule: CO-16 + N286 = data defect; correct_and_resubmit; Medicare Part B CLM05-3=1 only
